title: Report: 30+ Hidden GTA 6 Controls and Secret Mechanics Reported by RockstarINTEL
description: RockstarINTEL reports a community-compiled list of more than 30 hidden GTA 6 controls and secret mechanics spanning combat, driving, and flying, with exact inputs not yet specified.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Hidden Controls and Secret Mechanics Reported
socialHook: RockstarINTEL reports more than 30 hidden GTA 6 controls and secret mechanics found by the community.

sections.heading: What RockstarINTEL Reported
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL published a report listing more than 30 hidden controls and secret mechanics in Grand Theft Auto VI. The outlet said the features cover combat, driving, flying, and interactions with people and items. According to the article, the list was compiled by Reddit users u/fromouterspace1, u/jcgam, and other community members. RockstarINTEL did not present the mechanics as an official Rockstar Games announcement.

sections.heading: What Remains Unknown
paragraphs: The report does not specify the exact button combinations or identify which hidden interactions are officially implemented versus player discoveries. It is unclear whether Rockstar or Take-Two has acknowledged the list. Specific steps, locations, or cheat codes are not included in the RockstarINTEL summary and should be treated as unverified community reports until confirmed by the publisher.

sections.heading: Related GTA 6 Context
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL also noted in the same article that Grand Theft Auto VI reportedly sold over 30 million copies on its first day, a figure attributed to the outlet rather than an official Take-Two announcement. Separately, PC Gamer reported on unique playlists unlocked by scanning posters in Vice City, but that coverage is distinct from the controls list.
